title: No polynomial-size circuit bound
statement: For every natural number $c$ and every language $L$ of Boolean lists, there is no family of acyclic Boolean circuits with fan-in at most two that recognizes $L$ and whose circuit on inputs of length $n$ has size at most $n^c$ for every $n$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language of Boolean lists
